description: Allowlist of the certificate identities and OIDC issuers whose sigstore bundles count as an effect receipt (founder ruling #8759, 2026-11-28). The verifier holds no key: it verifies each bundle with gh attestation verify or cosign verify-blob-attestation against these pairs. A pair is enforced only in state 'verified'; a 'declared' pair is a declared intention and is ignored by the verifier.
note: Greenlane must never certify its own deployment, so greenlane.yml is NOT an allowed signer. The producer workflow (.github/workflows/effect-receipt.yml) signs one bundle; the other two issuers are declared, not verified, until their identities are measured.

signers.name: github-actions-effect-receipt
signers.note: The producer workflow on main. GitHub's OIDC issuer mints every workflow identity, so bundles signed here count as ONE issuer, never three.

signers.name: k3s-spiffe-effect-receipt
signers.note: Declared, not verified: the SPIFFE identity the k3s control plane would issue is not measured yet, so the verifier ignores this entry.

signers.name: cloudflare-edge-effect-receipt
signers.note: Declared, not verified: the edge identity is not measured yet, so the verifier ignores this entry.
